body: … that the new Episcopal bishop of Washington DC, the Right Rev. Mariann Budde, has recommended my book Finding Our Way Again as a resource for Lent. I’ve heard tremendous things about Bishop Mariann’s vision and manner (and her interest in systems thinking), and I hope the book will be a helpful resource to all.
